full_text:
Appendix (Regulations for the Enforcement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Fisheries and its Affiliated Institutions) <Item 1, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This regulation shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 7 are omitted.

Article 8 (Amendments to Other Regulations) Items ① through <35> are omitted.

<36> The following provisions of the "Regulations for the Establishment and Operation of the Livestock Fund" are amended:

In Article 2, replace "Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Fisheries" with "Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Fisheries."

In Article 9, replace "Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Fisheries" with "Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Fisheries," "Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Fisheries" with "Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Fisheries," and "Minister of Agriculture, Food and Fisheries" with "Minister of Agriculture, Food and Fisheries."

Articles <37> through <39> are omitted.
